the census probes what it says it probes > ⛔ AND THE CONTAINMENT CHECK BITES — a probe pointed at the wrong cell fails

the corpus is not vacuous > and a NEGATION wraps EVERY shape it can, not just the easy one

no rows, no groups
the first screen with enough matches wins
none with enough: the first pinned screen

waits on an unanswered count before the winner, not after it

no live price: the snapshot price and change

a live change with no live price is never paired with the snapshot price
menu opens, selects, closes and returns focus
escape closes
outside pointerdown closes (without stealing focus), inside pointerdown does not
arrow keys move between items

help menu lists reading, not actions
coverage drop detection
data receipt shows the date and counts

home and end jump to first and last item

receipt date handling: time component, bad input, missing

articles follow the sound
